title: Here's a demo for Deep Space Drilling Defense
author: PulIthEld
selftext:
Deep Space Drilling Defense is a game about drilling for resources while defending against swarms of alien creatures attracted to the sound of your operation.

Expand around the map while defending your moves with turrets, traps, walls and guile.

Balance your greed with your grit and try to drill all of the crystals before the hive overruns your defense.

Let me know what you think!

https://seeders.itch.io/deep-space-drilling-defense


Made with my own custom built javascript engine with an ECS pattern.  Used claude to program the games systems and create the models with Three.JS primitives and some generated textures.  

Didn't do any model generation. 

Sound is from Kenney Sci Fi sound effects

Music is from opengameart
